subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept these updated executable action pins across token, release, security-scanning, Docker-publishing, and Codex-agent workflows once the refreshed exact head is green?
rationale: The patch is mechanically coherent and no concrete vulnerability was found, but several actions execute with sensitive credentials or elevated repository permissions, so supply-chain acceptance requires human security ownership.

options.title: Approve after exact-head checks
options.body: Accept the full immutable-pin batch after rebasing and requiring actionlint, security, release, and workflow checks to pass on that exact head.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate token-, registry-, CodeQL-, builder-, and Codex-executing actions from lower-privilege setup and maintenance actions for narrower review.

options.title: Hold existing pins
options.body: Keep the current versions until an owner completes deeper upstream review or identifies a concrete compatibility concern.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head checks
recommendation.body: Accept the full immutable-pin batch after rebasing and requiring actionlint, security, release, and workflow checks to pass on that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest repository-history signal connects this person to release workflow ownership and validation around the most sensitive affected paths.
